UXUC80 is a procedural code utilized within the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) to specifically designate transthoracic echocardiography [^src1]. In the context of the national clinical quality guidelines for atrial fibrillation ("Atrieflimren i Danmark"), this code plays a critical role in measuring and tracking diagnostic compliance [^src1]. 

According to the technical calculation rules established by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), UXUC80 is one of the recognized procedure codes that qualify as a performed [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] for the fulfillment of clinical quality Indicator 2 [^src1]. By mapping precise codes like UXUC80, the RKKP can accurately calculate the numerators and denominators for these indicators, ensuring that evidence-based clinical standards for atrial fibrillation diagnostics are properly monitored across the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
